rows.grounds: tat+hasta+maṇibandhāt = from-that-hand-wrist; ablative singular of compound tad-hasta-maṇibandha
pārśva+madhyaṃ = side-middle; nominative or accusative singular neuter of compound pārśva-madhya (case AMBIGUOUS without wider context)
kalā+aṃgulam = one-kalā-aṅgula; nominative or accusative singular neuter of compound kalā-aṅgula (case AMBIGUOUS without wider context)
